d: Short, spiky chocolate-brown hair is swept upward, pairing with a mature, middle-aged face and a muscular, heavy-set build. Sharp, narrow eyes are framed by a glowing light-blue rectangular cybernetic visor over the right eye. The attire consists of a black sleeveless tactical vest over a black t-shirt, light-grey cargo pants with black knee pads, and black boots. Signature details include a glowing blue holographic interface on the left wrist and several firearms, including a tan-colored assault rifle held in front and a black sniper rifle slung across the back.
